text:
anya: quick check-in: i want to add a "perf-smoke sampler" into onboarding. low-cost checks always, longer runs sampled. goal: detect ABI/correctness fast and catch perf regressions cheaply.
chris: +1. keep the default non-blocking for small perf blips. ABI/correctness should block.
tejas: add a KV-cache steady-state probe after warmup for mid/long runs. otherwise we wont see throughput drops.
lina: sampling heuristic idea: prob_long = clamp(0.03 * (1 / sqrt(size_gb)), 0.005, 0.2). store seed+jobid so samples are repeatable.
anya: draft manifest snippet i'll PR: "perf_sampler_enabled: true; checks: [ {seq:32, repeat:1}, {seq:256, repeat:3, warmup:2}, {seq:1024, repeat:5, warmup:3, sample:dynamic} ]; outcomes: ABI_FAIL->block, CORRECTNESS_FAIL->block, PERF_DEGRADED->halt_canary"
marco: ops: agree block on ABI/correctness. perf_degraded -> halt canary + alert + postmortem before proceed. teams can opt into auto-rollback if they want.
chris: infra please emit est_gpu_minutes per job and per-check breakdown so product can show cost tradeoffs.
infra-bot: queued perf-smoke/1766667777 on rdx-dedicated-2  status=queued  est_gpu_minutes=3.1
tejas: also log compact artifact fingerprint (abi_hash, qtype) on job metadata for diffs.
anya: great. i'll open RFC PR with YAML, sampling formula, thresholds spreadsheet, and a dev-mode to run without billing. ping reviewers when up.
